quizzes_via_update.description: Quiz sections are inserted with empty content, then metadata is updated via a separate UPDATE statement. The AI should generate quiz sections with empty content and provide the metadata JSONB separately.
quizzes_via_update.quiz_update_sql_pattern: UPDATE lesson_sections SET metadata = '{"question": "...", "options": [...], "correct_index": N, "explanation": "..."}'::jsonb WHERE section_type = 'quiz' AND title = 'Quiz Title Here' AND lesson_id = (SELECT l.id FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = 'course-slug' AND m.slug = 'module-slug' AND l.slug = 'lesson-slug');

multi_file_exercise_metadata.description: Used in exercise sections when no problem_references exist and you want a multi-file tabbed editor instead of single-file. Store in section.metadata as JSONB with key 'multiFile'.
multi_file_exercise_metadata.note: Multi-file exercises are Python-only (executed via Pyodide in-browser). Go exercises are single-file standalone editor only.

all_default_visible_false.description: Every entity (course, module, lesson, section, project) defaults to visible=false. Admins publish via toggle. Students only see visible=true items. Invisible items return 404 to students.

unique_slugs.description: Course slug is globally unique. Module slug is unique per course. Lesson slug is unique per module. Project slug is unique per lesson.

rules.quiz_ordering_note: Quizzes are frontend-grouped into one Quiz Review step at the end regardless of their order_number. Non-quiz sections maintain their order_number ordering.
rules.xp_first_completion_only: XP is awarded only on first lesson completion. Re-completing a lesson grants 0 XP. Default lesson XP is 50. Default project XP is 100.
rules.progress_never_decreases: Course progress percentage and XP awarded never decrease (GREATER NEVER DECREASE pattern using GREATEST() SQL). completed_at timestamps are preserved on re-completion.
rules.dependency_dag: Lessons can depend on prerequisite lessons within the same module. No self-dependencies allowed. Dependencies are lesson slugs within the same module. Backend returns 403 PREREQ_NOT_MET if any prereq is incomplete.
rules.dollar_quoting: Multi-line content with embedded single quotes should use dollar-quoting ($py$...$py$) in the SQL. Short single-line content can use standard single quotes with escaping.
rules.problem_references_exist: The problems table has ~263 existing problems across 15 modules. Common ones: error-message-for-code, is-valid-email, py-avg-calculator, py-trim-ends, plus many math/string/array problems.

sql_generation_guide.course_insert: INSERT INTO courses (slug, title, description, difficulty_level, estimated_hours, order_number, visible) VALUES ('{slug}', '{title}', '{description}', {difficulty}, {hours}, {order}, false) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;
sql_generation_guide.module_insert: INSERT INTO modules (course_id, slug, title, description, order_number, visible) SELECT c.id, '{slug}', '{title}', '{description}', {order}, false FROM courses c WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' ON CONFLICT (course_id, slug) DO NOTHING;
sql_generation_guide.lesson_insert: INSERT INTO lessons (module_id, slug, title, description, difficulty, estimated_minutes, xp_reward, order_number, visible, problem_references) SELECT m.id, '{slug}', '{title}', '{description}', {difficulty}, {minutes}, {xp}, {order}, false, ARRAY[{refs}]::TEXT[] FROM modules m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' ON CONFLICT (module_id, slug) DO NOTHING;
sql_generation_guide.section_insert: INSERT INTO lesson_sections (lesson_id, section_type, title, content, order_number) SELECT l.id, '{type}', '{title}', $py${content}$py$, {order} FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{lesson_slug}';
sql_generation_guide.quiz_metadata_update: UPDATE lesson_sections SET metadata = '{jsonb}'::jsonb WHERE section_type = 'quiz' AND title = '{quiz_title}' AND lesson_id = (SELECT l.id FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{lesson_slug}');
sql_generation_guide.dependency_insert: INSERT INTO lesson_dependencies (lesson_id, depends_on_lesson_id) SELECT (SELECT l.id FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{dependent_slug}'), (SELECT l.id FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{prereq_slug}') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
sql_generation_guide.project_insert: INSERT INTO projects (lesson_id, slug, title, description, requirements, starter_code, difficulty, xp_reward, hints, order_number, visible) SELECT l.id, '{slug}', '{title}', '{description}', $py${requirements}$py$, $py${starter_code}$py$, {difficulty}, {xp}, ARRAY[{hints}]::TEXT[], {order}, false FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{lesson_slug}' ON CONFLICT (lesson_id, slug) DO NOTHING;
sql_generation_guide.multi_file_metadata_update: UPDATE lesson_sections SET metadata = '{"multiFile": {files}}}}'::jsonb WHERE section_type = 'exercises' AND title = '{section_title}' AND lesson_id = (SELECT l.id FROM lessons l JOIN modules m ON l.module_id = m.id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.id WHERE c.slug = '{course_slug}' AND m.slug = '{module_slug}' AND l.slug = '{lesson_slug}');
